trans-unit.source: How many readings can I do per day?
Every day you get 2 Cards of the Day and 6 readings in the other spreads. The limits reset at midnight UTC; the Home screen shows how many are left.
trans-unit.note: Answer about daily limits; Cards of the Day is the plural of a spread name in the app

trans-unit.source: Why do I need to sign in?
Your readings and history are stored in your account, so they are not lost when you change or reinstall your phone, and daily limits are counted per account. You can sign in with Google or Apple.
No. Isomantika is made for entertainment. Interpretations are written by AI: treat them as a prompt for reflection, not as a prediction or professional advice.

trans-unit.source: Write to us — we reply by email.

Isomantika is a tarot app for iOS and Android. You ask a question, pick one of 12 spreads, draw cards from the original 1909 Rider–Waite deck, and AI writes an interpretation of the spread for your question — in English, Russian or Spanish.
How do I change the language, theme or card back?
Open Settings → Appearance. There you can choose the language (System, English, Russian or Spanish), the theme (Dark, Light or System) and one of five card back designs.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Appearance» must match the app menu

trans-unit.source: Where can I find my past readings?
In the History tab. Every reading is saved there automatically.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «History» is the tab name in the app

trans-unit.source: How do I remove a reading from history?
In History, swipe the reading away and confirm. Removing a reading doesn't give back a reading for today.
trans-unit.note: Answer about removing a reading from history

trans-unit.source: How do I delete my account?
Open Settings → Account → Delete account. Your account and all your readings are deleted immediately and permanently.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Account → Delete account» must match the app menu
Link to the account deletion page

trans-unit.source: How do I contact support from the app?
Open Settings → About → Contact support. The email already contains the app version and your user ID, which helps us answer faster.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → About → Contact support» must match the app menu

trans-unit.source: With your consent we use Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica to understand how the site is used. Nothing is loaded until you decide.
